# Variable `BUILD_RANLIB`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

Specifies the architecture-specific utility to generate indexes for archives for the build host, and its default definition is derived in part from BUILD_PREFIX:

```
BUILD_RANLIB = "${BUILD_PREFIX}ranlib -D"

```

When building a native recipe, RANLIB is set to the value of this variable by default.

The BUILD_RANLIB variable should not be set manually, and is rarely used in recipes as RANLIB contains the appropriate value depending on the context (native or target recipes). Exception be made for target recipes that need to use the utility from the build host at some point during the build.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-BUILD_RANLIB
